title: Chetan Prakash shows quantum wave functions arise from Markov chains

plain: A scientist who studies perception and consciousness, Donald Hoffman, says his collaborator Chetan Prakash has shown that, in certain cases, the quantum wave functions that describe free particles are exactly the same thing as Markov chains, a kind of math model for systems that hop at random between states. Hoffman thinks the result is quite general, and for him it hints that physics might rest on something deeper than space and time.
